recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit separately only if FHIR-28461 or another future final Patient Care decision changes the broader CareTeam lifecycle or multi-patient modeling guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-28457 is a Published FHIR-core Patient Care change request resolved Persuasive for R5. It asked to clarify CareTeam.subject usage: use Group when care is provided to all members of the group, such as group therapy, and use Patient when care is provided to an individual patient.
initial_application: Commit 1efc5c2ddbb05bbbea16689f07d7a90f378622b6, "J#28457 - CareTeam.subject clarification", added the requested CareTeam.subject comment to source/careteam/structuredefinition-CareTeam.xml. Current git blame still attributes the comment to that Jira-tagged application commit.
additional_context: CareTeam is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/careteam/structuredefinition-CareTeam.xml is in build scope. The linked Zulip thread shows the original question about static CareTeams, Group, and multiple patient-specific CareTeam instances. Related issue FHIR-28461 remains Waiting for Input and concerns a broader unresolved static multi-patient CareTeam use case. Later CareTeam boundary edits preserved the subject comment and did not reverse FHIR-28457.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current CareTeam.subject definition already includes the exact approved guidance and retains Patient and Group target profiles.

related_jiras.note: Linked from the Jira comments and original discussion, but still Waiting for Input and focused on a broader static multi-patient CareTeam use case.
